original.text: Optiv closed a lender agreement amending and extending its First Lien Credit Agreement to August 2028 and Second Lien to August 2029.

original.text: Cisco disclosed a $1 billion restructuring charge in an 8-K filing, including charges related to Splunk integration.

candidates.reason: The cited Cisco-wide filing describes estimated future charges up to 1 billion. It does not establish a fixed realized 1 billion charge or allocate an amount to Splunk; no inference that Splunk was excluded is made.
candidates.draftDatedCorrection: Correction, [publication date]. The Splunk restructuring entry described a fixed $1 billion charge that included Splunk integration. The cited Cisco filing describes estimated future company-wide charges of up to $1 billion and provides no Splunk allocation. The Splunk-specific entry is withdrawn pending supporting evidence.

candidates.reason: The September filing supports the CRO transition only. The unrelated Raj Judge board resignation is April 15, not the April 16 signature date, and is already recorded in EV-zscaler-7. Remove the incorrect duplicated clause.
candidates.draftDatedCorrection: Correction, [publication date]. The Zscaler entry dated 24 September 2026 included an unrelated board resignation with an incorrect effective date.
